manifest.name: POS Self Order Razorpay
manifest.summary: Addon for the Self Order App that allows customers to pay by Razorpay POS Terminal.
manifest.author: Odoo S.A.

models._description: Point of Sale Payment Methods (Razorpay self-order/kiosk bridge)

security.note: no module-owned access rules/groups; reuses point_of_sale POS groups and the pos_self_order public access-token gate (_verify_pos_config). Routes declared website=True.

views.note: no views; pure JS/controller bridge, 0 XML LOC. Razorpay device/credential fields live on the parent pos_razorpay payment-method form.

behavioral_notes.observation: The bridge adds no fields and wires Razorpay into the kiosk via two pos.payment.method overrides. _payment_request_from_kiosk overrides pos_self_order's no-op hook: it returns super() unless self.use_payment_terminal == 'razorpay', otherwise it builds a Razorpay request dict (amount = order.amount_total -- NOT scaled, unlike the Pine Labs sibling; referenceId = '<config-name>/Order/<order.id>/<uuid4>') and calls the parent module's self.razorpay_make_payment_request(data), which POSTs the 'pay' endpoint to the Razorpay POS device and returns {'success': True, 'p2pRequestId': ...}. _load_pos_self_data_domain (@api.model) OR-extends pos_self_order's data-load domain so that, when config.self_ordering_mode == 'kiosk', the Razorpay methods on config.payment_method_ids are shipped to the public kiosk OWL client (otherwise excluded by the base [('id','=',False)] domain). This is the terminal-enabling config switch and is invisible to field metadata.

The two module routes are the poll/cancel surface, not the payment trigger. The trigger is pos_self_order's own /kiosk/payment/<pos_config_id>/kiosk (jsonrpc, public), to which the JS Razorpay.processPayment posts the serialized order. That base route runs process_order (creating the pos.order in the open pos.session via sync_from_ui), browses the chosen pos.payment.method, calls payment_method_sudo._payment_request_from_kiosk(order_sudo) -- dispatching into this module's Razorpay override -- and returns {'order': _load_pos_self_data_read(...), 'payment_status': status} where status carries the p2pRequestId. So the kiosk creates the order and starts the Razorpay device transaction in one round-trip, then the client polls. Access on every call is gated by _verify_pos_config(access_token), which resolves the pos.config by access_token and drops privileges to its self_ordering_default_user_id.

The two new public jsonrpc routes (both website=True) subclass PosSelfOrderController and drive the asynchronous device result. /pos-self-order/razorpay-fetch-payment-status/ verifies the config (_verify_pos_config), searches the pos.order by (id, config_id) (Unauthorized if missing), and calls payment_method.razorpay_fetch_payment_status(payment_data) (parent 'status' poll keyed by p2pRequestId; the parent maps Razorpay messageCodes -> AUTHORIZED/QUEUED/SENT/RECEIVED/FAILED). On status == 'AUTHORIZED' it writes a pos.payment via order.add_payment({amount: order.amount_total, payment_method_id, card_type=paymentCardType, cardholder_name=nameOnCard, transaction_id=txnId, payment_method_authcode=authCode, card_brand=paymentCardBrand, payment_method_issuer_bank=acquirerCode, card_no=cardLastFourDigit, payment_ref_no=externalRefNumber, razorpay_reverse_ref_no=reverseReferenceNumber, ...}), then order.action_pos_order_paid() and, if self_ordering_mode == 'kiosk', call_bus_service(order, 'Success') -> order._send_payment_result('Success') (config._notify('PAYMENT_STATUS') + receipt + kitchen order). On status FAILED or empty it call_bus_service(order, 'fail'). /pos-self-order/razorpay-cancel-transaction/ calls razorpay_cancel_payment_request(payment_data) (parent 'cancel' endpoint) and, on success, also call_bus_service(order, 'fail'). The poll is the only path from device approval to a paid order; none of this is in metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (OWL self-order kiosk PaymentPage/SelfOrder Razorpay handler) -- gap #3
behavioral_notes.observation: The client side is plain JS on the pos_self_order public OWL app (3 JS files, 0 OWL components, bundle pos_self_order.assets): a non-OWL Razorpay class (static/src/app/razorpay.js) plus patches of PaymentPage.prototype (static/src/app/pages/payment_page/payment_page.js) and SelfOrder.prototype (static/src/app/services/self_order_service.js). PaymentPage.startPayment delegates to selfOrder.razorpay.startPayment when the selected method's use_payment_terminal === 'razorpay'; SelfOrder.setup instantiates Razorpay if a razorpay method is loaded and SelfOrder.filterPaymentMethods force-includes razorpay methods on the kiosk payment screen. Razorpay.startPayment posts to /kiosk/payment to create the order + start the device, then paymentPolling() calls /pos-self-order/razorpay-fetch-payment-status/ every REQUEST_TIMEOUT (10s), stashing p2pRequestId in localStorage; a 'QUEUED' status triggers a cancel+restart of the transaction, a 90s inactivity timer flips payment_stopped and auto-fires /pos-self-order/razorpay-cancel-transaction/, and a RazorpayError notification reports device errors. This poll/queue/cancel loop and localStorage correlation are client logic not reverse-engineerable from Python.

it_architecture.application: pos_self_order_razorpay (thin auto-installed bridge: wires the Razorpay POS terminal -- from pos_razorpay -- into the pos_self_order kiosk self-payment flow via a pos.payment.method override + two public poll/cancel routes + OWL kiosk patches)
software_services: /pos-self-order/razorpay-fetch-payment-status/ (public jsonrpc, website=True; poll Razorpay device status, settle pos.payment on AUTHORIZED, bus-notify Success/fail)
/pos-self-order/razorpay-cancel-transaction/ (public jsonrpc, website=True; cancel the in-flight Razorpay transaction, bus-notify fail)
logical_data_erm: pos.payment.method -> pos.config (config_ids; kiosk configs whose payment_method_ids include the Razorpay method)
pos.payment.method -> pos.payment (the tender written by order.add_payment, base POS model)
pos.order -> pos.session (order created in the open session by /kiosk/payment process_order, base pos_self_order)
information_flows: depends: pos_self_order (kiosk app, /kiosk/payment, _payment_request_from_kiosk hook, _send_payment_result bus) + pos_razorpay (use_payment_terminal='razorpay', razorpay_make/fetch/cancel terminal methods, p2pRequestId)
client->server: kiosk PaymentPage -> SelfOrder.razorpay.startPayment -> /kiosk/payment/<config>/kiosk -> _payment_request_from_kiosk -> razorpay_make_payment_request ('pay') -> p2pRequestId

settlement: on 'AUTHORIZED' -> order.add_payment (pos.payment) -> action_pos_order_paid -> (kiosk) call_bus_service -> _send_payment_result('Success') -> config._notify('PAYMENT_STATUS') + receipt + kitchen order
queue/cancel: 'QUEUED' -> cancel + restart; inactivity (90s)/FAILED -> /pos-self-order/razorpay-cancel-transaction/ -> razorpay_cancel_payment_request ('cancel') -> call_bus_service(fail)
indirect outbound: the actual HTTPS calls to the Razorpay POS device API (RazorpayPosRequest._call_razorpay) live in pos_razorpay, not in this bridge
frontend_components: PaymentPage.prototype (patch; route razorpay payments to Razorpay.startPayment)
SelfOrder.prototype (patch; instantiate Razorpay, force-include razorpay methods, RazorpayError notifications)

capabilities: Accept Self-Service Kiosk Card/UPI/QR Payment via the Razorpay POS Terminal
Settle an Authorized Razorpay Transaction into the Kiosk Order (pos.payment)
Cancel / Re-queue an In-Flight Kiosk Terminal Transaction (QUEUED handling, timeout)
Expose the Razorpay Payment Method to the Kiosk Self-Order Client (kiosk-mode only)
value_streams: Kiosk-self-pay-by-Razorpay: diner confirms order at the kiosk -> /kiosk/payment creates the pos.order + sends the 'pay' request to the Razorpay device -> customer taps card/UPI/QR on the device -> kiosk polls 'status' -> on AUTHORIZED a pos.payment is written, the order is marked paid, and (kiosk) a PAYMENT_STATUS bus message + receipt/kitchen order are emitted
information_concepts: pos.payment (base; tender line written on authorization)
pos.config (base; kiosk config exposing the terminal)
organization: (no module-owned res.groups; reuses point_of_sale POS groups and the pos_self_order self_ordering_default_user_id public actor)
policies: _payment_request_from_kiosk only acts when use_payment_terminal == 'razorpay' (else delegates to super)
amount is sent unscaled (order.amount_total); parent pos_razorpay constrains the terminal to INR currency
Razorpay methods are loaded to the public kiosk client only when self_ordering_mode == 'kiosk' (_load_pos_self_data_domain OR-extension)
every route re-verifies the pos.config by access_token (_verify_pos_config) and finds the order by (id, config_id) (Unauthorized otherwise)
a paid order is only produced on a polled 'AUTHORIZED'; 'QUEUED' triggers cancel+restart and inactivity (90s)/FAILED bus-notifies 'fail'
stakeholders: Customer / diner (taps card/UPI/QR on the Razorpay device at the kiosk)
Razorpay POS Terminal / Razorpay POS API (external payment device/provider, via pos_razorpay)
Restaurant / Store Manager (configures the Razorpay method on the kiosk pos.config)
Accountant (consumes the resulting pos.payment via the base POS session closing entry)
metrics: Razorpay kiosk tender amounts roll up via base pos.payment / report.pos.order (no module-specific report)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: pos_self_order_razorpay is a thin payment-terminal bridge inside the in-store self-service checkout: its sole act is collecting the customer's tender on the Razorpay POS device and completing a pos.payment on the kiosk pos.order so the order can be marked paid. That places it on the retail Sell/checkout primary activity of the value chain (Stabell & Fjeldstad chain / transform), inherited from its point_of_sale -> pos_self_order lineage, and maps to APQC 3.0 (Market and Sell Products and Services) because the operation it adds -- capturing payment to close the kiosk sale -- is part of selling/closing the counter transaction, not treasury/AR (APQC 9.0), realized downstream by the base POS session closing entry. It carries a 'network' overtone (it mediates between the diner and the Razorpay device/API through public poll/cancel routes), but, like its pos_safaricom / pos_online_payment siblings, the value logic it actually completes is the chain sell transaction, so it is classified chain. (The host pos_self_order is itself classed 'network' as the mediating self-order channel; this child adds only a tender device to that channel's kiosk mode, so it is read with the underlying POS sell rather than the channel mediation.)

standard_capabilities: pay a self-service kiosk order with the Razorpay POS terminal (use_payment_terminal = 'razorpay')
automatic kiosk order creation + device payment request in one /kiosk/payment round-trip
client-side status polling (10s) of the Razorpay device until AUTHORIZED, then automatic pos.payment + order-paid
QUEUED-status auto cancel+restart and ~90s-inactivity auto-cancel, with PAYMENT_STATUS bus fail signal
Razorpay method auto-exposed to the kiosk client only in kiosk self-ordering mode
typical_fits: Indian (INR) quick-service / retail self-order kiosks taking card/UPI/QR on a Razorpay device
a Razorpay method configured on the kiosk pos.config.payment_method_ids (device serial/credentials on the pos_razorpay method)
kiosk pay-each flow where the diner settles at the kiosk before the order goes to the kitchen
common_gaps: INR-only (parent pos_razorpay currency constraint) -- not usable for non-INR kiosks
completion depends on client polling staying alive; a closed kiosk tab mid-poll leaves the device txn to the inactivity cancel
no module-specific reconciliation/reporting beyond the base pos.payment line (refund/void live in pos_razorpay, not exposed to the kiosk)
QUEUED storm: repeated cancel+restart if the device keeps queuing could loop without operator visibility
depends on pos_razorpay reaching the Razorpay POS API ('pay'/'status'/'cancel'); endpoint changes need edits there
drive_hints: curl jsonrpc /pos-self-order/razorpay-fetch-payment-status/ with {'access_token':cfg.access_token,'order_id':...,'payment_data':{'p2pRequestId':...},'payment_method_id':...} (expect Unauthorized without a valid token/order)
open a kiosk POS (self_ordering_mode='kiosk') with a Razorpay method and place an order to trigger PaymentPage.startPayment -> Razorpay.startPayment

open_questions: Exact OWL correlation: how the kiosk PaymentPage reacts to the PAYMENT_STATUS bus notification after the server already wrote the pos.payment on the poll.
QUEUED handling robustness: bounds on the cancel+restart loop when the Razorpay device repeatedly returns QUEUED.
Race between the 90s inactivity cancel and a late device AUTHORIZED when the diner walks away.
Idempotency of repeated /pos-self-order/razorpay-fetch-payment-status/ calls returning AUTHORIZED (double add_payment guarded only by action_pos_order_paid state).
